## T3 Table

L1104 - L1565


```{r}
base_path <- "~/Documents/OneDrive - The University of Colorado Denver/Liu, Alison's files - Raw/2025-07-09/"
file_name <- list.files(base_path,
                        full.names = TRUE,
                        pattern = "\\.csv$")

## Get file info including size
file_info <- file.info(file_name)
# file_info
## Extract size in megabytes
file_info$size_mb <- round(file_info$size / (1024^2), 2)
```


```{r}
# Show file name and size
data.frame(file = basename(rownames(file_info)),
           size_MB = file_info$size_mb) %>% 
  separate(file, 
           into = c("file", "number",
                    "content", "date"),
           sep = "_", extra = "merge") %>%
```

## Small Tables T2,4,6,9,12,13,14,15,17

```{r}
file.path(file_name[[13]])

## those are the files small size
## do not need to be subseted
T3 <- file.path(file_name[[13]]) %>% 
  read_csv() %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  mutate(studyid = arb_person_id,
         visitdate = ymd(encounterdate),
         visityr = year(visitdate)) %>%
  mutate(source_icd = case_when(provenance == "Billing Diagnosis" ~ 1L,
                                provenance == "Encounter Diagnosis" ~ 2L,
                                provenance == "Problem List" ~ 3L,
                                TRUE ~ NA_integer_)) %>% 
  arrange(arb_person_id, encounterdate, source_icd, diagnosiscode) %>%
  group_by(arb_person_id, encounterdate, source_icd) %>%
  mutate(noicd = row_number(),
         maxnoicd = max(noicd)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(source_icd == 1) %>%
  select(-problemonsetdate, -problemresolutondate, -provenance,
         -source_icd, -noicd, -maxnoicd, -diagnosiscodetype) %>%
  mutate(ded_icd = case_when(str_detect(diagnosiscode, "H16\\.221|H16\\.222|H16\\.223") ~ 0,
                             str_detect(diagnosiscode, "H11\\.141|H11\\.142|H11\\.143") ~ 1,
                             str_detect(diagnosiscode, "H04\\.121|H04\\.122|H04\\.123") ~ 2,
                             str_detect(diagnosiscode, "H16\\.211|H16\\.212|H16\\.213") ~ 3,
                             str_detect(diagnosiscode, "M35\\.01") ~ 4,
                             str_detect(diagnosiscode, "M35\\.00") ~ 5,
                             str_detect(diagnosiscode, "H16\\.101|H16\\.102|H16\\.103") ~ 6,
                             str_detect(diagnosiscode, "H16\\.121|H16\\.122|H16\\.123") ~ 7,
                             str_detect(diagnosiscode, "H16\\.141|H16\\.142|H16\\.143") ~ 8,
                             str_detect(diagnosiscode, "H16\\.231|H16\\.232|H16\\.233") ~ 9,
                             str_detect(diagnosiscode, "H18\\.831|H18\\.832|H18\\.833") ~ 10,
                             str_detect(diagnosiscode, "H02\\.88") ~ 11,
                             TRUE ~ NA_real_)) %>%
  mutate(ot_icd = case_when(str_detect(diagnosiscode, "L51\\.1|L51\\.3") ~ 1,
                            str_detect(diagnosiscode, "M35\\.0A|M35\\.0B|M35\\.0C") ~ 2,
                            str_detect(diagnosiscode, "D89\\.811") ~ 3,
                            str_detect(diagnosiscode, "D89\\.813") ~ 4,
                            str_detect(diagnosiscode, "L71\\.9|L71\\.8") ~ 5,
                            str_detect(diagnosiscode, "H10\\.82") ~ 6,
                            str_detect(diagnosiscode, "^H01") ~ 7,
                            str_detect(diagnosiscode, "L71\\.0") ~ 8,
                            str_detect(diagnosiscode, "L71\\.1") ~ 9,
                            str_detect(diagnosiscode, "M06\\.9") ~ 10,
                            str_detect(diagnosiscode, "M32\\.9") ~ 11,
                            str_detect(diagnosiscode, "^E0(8|9|10|11|13)") ~ 12,
                            str_detect(diagnosiscode, "E50\\.7") ~ 13,
                            TRUE ~ NA_real_)) %>%
  mutate(symp_icd = case_when(str_detect(diagnosiscode, "H53\\.141|H53\\.142|H53\\.143") ~ 1,
                              str_detect(diagnosiscode, "H57\\.11|H57\\.12|H57\\.13") ~ 2,
                              str_detect(diagnosiscode, "H04\\.201|H04\\.202|H04\\.203") ~ 3,
                              str_detect(diagnosiscode, "H53\\.8") ~ 4,
                              TRUE ~ NA_real_)) %>%
  group_by(studyid, visitdate) %>%
  mutate(eyelid = ded_icd == 11,
         lids = sum(eyelid, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!(ded_icd == 11 & lids > 1)) %>%
  mutate(empty_record = is.na(ded_icd) & is.na(ot_icd) & is.na(symp_icd)) %>%
  filter(!empty_record) %>%
  group_by(studyid, visitdate) %>%
  mutate(seqno = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = c(studyid, visitdate),
                     names_from = seqno,
                     values_from = c(ded_icd, ot_icd, symp_icd),
                     names_sep = "") %>%
  mutate(num_ded_icd = rowSums(!is.na(select(., starts_with("ded_icd")))),
         num_ot_icd = rowSums(!is.na(select(., starts_with("ot_icd")))),
         num_symp_icd = rowSums(!is.na(select(., starts_with("symp_icd")))))
```
